video: 30-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how text embeddings let search find what you mean

search_bar_enter.what: The search bar fades in and rises into place at the top

query_typing.what: 'cheap laptop' types into the search bar at a steady pace

cursor_blink.what: A violet text cursor blinks steadily in the search bar

product_card_enter.what: A product card fades in and slides into place below the search bar

word_match_lines.what: Lines draw from each search word toward each product word and stop halfway

word_match_x.what: A violet X draws where each word-match line stops

decoy_match_line.what: A line draws from 'laptop' in the search to 'Laptop' on the Laptop bag card

decoy_question_mark.what: A violet question mark fades in next to the decoy match

word_match_exit.what: The word-match lines and marks fade away

model_enter.what: The embedding model box fades in and grows slightly into place

paths_draw.what: Curved purple lines draw from the query and the cards into the model

query_pill_travel.what: A violet copy of the query leaves the search bar and travels into the model, shrinking

cards_into_model.what: The product cards travel into the model and shrink as they enter

model_pulse.what: The model briefly swells and settles as the texts enter it

vector_rows_emerge.what: Rows of numbers rise out of the model, one per text

map_axes_draw.what: The two axes of the meaning map draw themselves

rows_fold_to_points.what: Each row of numbers shrinks and moves to become a point on the map

arrows_draw.what: Arrows draw from the map's origin to each point

points_appear.what: Each point appears at the end of its arrow

neighborhood_glow.what: A soft glow grows around the query point and its closest match

angle_arc_draw.what: A purple arc draws the small angle between the query arrow and its closest match

points_to_results.what: The map points fly up and grow into ranked result cards with scores

scores_note_enter.what: A note saying the scores are illustrative fades in

use_icons_enter.what: Three icons for search, recommendations and AI assistants fade in and rise, one after another

caption_enter.what: A short explanation line fades in and rises

caption_exit.what: The explanation line fades out before the next one appears

camera_zoom.what: The camera zooms out slightly as the scene fades into the logo

world_fade_out.what: The whole scene fades away before the logo appears

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them

logo_bars_grow.what: Four logo bars grow upward from a baseline one after another, left to right

logo_wordmark_reveal.what: The brand name is revealed left to right by a moving edge

logo_glow.what: The logo bars glow brighter, then settle to a soft glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place under the logo

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow on the button slides a little to the right once
